name: Tessera Corponation Laminar Ghost Chassis
description:
The Laminar Ghost Chassis is Tessera Corponation's flagship stealth suit — a full-body garment system that combines passive thermal baffling, acoustic dampening laminate, and a dynamic optical surface layer into a unified platform. The outer surface is composed of Tessera's proprietary Fold-Reactive polymer, which samples ambient light from micro-aperture sensors distributed across the suit and re-emits it through a micro-LED matrix on the opposing surface, creating a near-real-time visual camouflage effect that is effective against human observers and most standard optical surveillance systems at ranges beyond four meters. The effect degrades noticeably at close range and breaks down entirely under ultraviolet or multispectral scanning.

Beneath the optical layer, the Ghost Chassis incorporates a passive thermal baffling membrane that suppresses the wearer's infrared signature to approximately ambient temperature within 90 seconds of activation, and an acoustic dampening laminate that reduces movement noise to below 15 decibels at normal walking pace. The suit is powered by a distributed micro-cell array woven through the lining, providing up to six hours of full active operation before requiring recharge. Tessera has positioned the Ghost Chassis as an intelligence-gathering and infiltration tool rather than a combat platform — the underlying armor protection is modest, rated for light fragmentation and minimal ballistic resistance.

The Ghost Chassis is tightly controlled by Tessera, sold exclusively through authorized intelligence-sector procurement channels and issued under strict end-user licensing agreements. Despite this, several units have surfaced in the hands of corporate espionage teams, high-end criminal organizations, and at least one documented case involving a Meridian 88 investigative journalist who used one to document a restricted Tessera research facility — an incident that resulted in significant legal action and the journalist's disappearance.

specifications.coverage: Full body including hood and gloves
specifications.optical_camouflage_failure_modes: UV light, multispectral scanning, ranges under 4m

tactical_use: The Ghost Chassis is optimized for reconnaissance, infiltration, and exfiltration in controlled environments. Operators are trained to move slowly and deliberately — rapid movement creates artifacts in the optical layer that are detectable even at range. The suit is most effective in low-light conditions where the optical camouflage is supplemented by natural shadow. Standard counter-tactics include UV flood lighting, multispectral scanning sweeps, and acoustic sensors below the suit's dampening threshold.
cultural_context: The Ghost Chassis exists in a space of near-mythological status in Meridian 88's intelligence and criminal communities. Its rarity and the legal risk of possessing one make it a symbol of extreme capability and resource. Tessera's aggressive enforcement of end-user agreements — including rumored remote-deactivation and self-destruct capabilities built into the power array — means that owning one outside of sanctioned channels is understood to be a direct confrontation with the corporation. Some operators refer to unsanctioned Ghost Chassis units as 'orphans,' acknowledging their precarious status.
known_users: Unknown — recovered unit, identity of operator undetermined
Sera Nacht (alias — wanted by Tessera for unauthorized possession)
story_hooks: A Ghost Chassis has been recovered from a crime scene where the wearer was killed — Tessera's recovery team arrived before law enforcement and removed it, but the players witnessed the exchange.
Tessera has remotely deactivated a Ghost Chassis while the operator was in the middle of a deep-cover infiltration — the timing suggests an inside leak, and the operator is now trapped.
A fence is offering a Ghost Chassis at a price that is suspiciously low — the unit may have been allowed to 'escape' Tessera's supply chain as bait for identifying unauthorized buyers.

The investigative journalist who used a Ghost Chassis to document a Tessera facility left encrypted footage that only surfaces when the suit's power array is activated — the suit is the key, and multiple parties want it.
